record.step: Merge: mixed replies and custom Other answers on escalated findings
record.event: When escalating D005@r4 Round 1 findings via AskQuestion (transcript L107), the user supplied custom Other text containing follow-up questions and counterproposals; unlike canon-grill Record (line 53), canon-blind-review Merge has no mixed-reply rule, so the agent silently assumed answers, edited docs (L108–L136), and launched confirmation (L138) until the user interrupted (L139).
record.suggestion: Cross-link canon-grill's mixed-reply rule from Merge: when a user's reply to escalated findings—including custom Other text in a structured question tool—asks a question or proposes an alternative, answer in chat and wait for confirmation on unsettled items before editing or launching confirmation.

record.step: Targeted recheck: no escalation stop-rule for lingering or new blockers
record.event: Confirmation (line 125) says 'Blockers still open after this round go to the user', but Targeted recheck (line 129) states no escalation trigger when a recheck still leaves blockers open or introduces new blockers; after D005@r4 cross-family-recheck.md kept F2/F5 open (transcript L177, L195), the agent self-looped into speculative private-API edits and recheck2 (L197) before escalating at L200, discarding those edits and spending two more rounds (recheck3 and recheck4).
record.suggestion: State explicitly in Targeted recheck that any blocker still open or newly introduced after a targeted recheck escalates back to the user before further edits or another recheck.

record.step: workflow.md: Review gate step 4 (guarantee sweep across concepts and diagrams)
record.event:
workflow.md line 54 asks to search 'the affected designs and their sketches for the old claim, equivalent wording and its exceptions', omitting project-overview concepts (such as Silk's C001) and line-wrapped diagram labels (Mermaid
breaks like 'per
visible non-P2P GPU island'); D005@r4 cross-family:F8 survived three consecutive confirmation/recheck passes through missed C001 lines (294, 259) and Mermaid labels (C001:99, D005:39, D005:52).
record.suggestion:
Expand workflow.md step 4 to mention affected project-overview concepts and diagram/table labels (including line-wrapped Mermaid
text) alongside designs and sketches.
